summary: Pair 02 (Lesson 2 + Worksheet 2) passes round 2 cleanly. R2 lifts all landed: Penny's refrain 'TWO PARTS make a WHOLE — that's how Penny adds!' is chanted 3x with claps in BOTH minds_on and consolidation/exit_routine, giving the unit its quotable carry-between-lessons chant. expanded_walkthrough.rationale now cites Carpenter & Moser CGI (1983) part-part-whole, Resnick (1983) commutativity, Baroody (2006) addition phases (counting-all -> counting-on -> direct retrieval), and Fuson (1992) count-up-to by name. recovery_moves are rewritten as three explicit diagnostic branches (DIAGNOSTIC A: total-changes-when-hidden -> chorus-count first; DIAGNOSTIC B: counts-all from 1 -> Fuson count-up-to rescue; DIAGNOSTIC C: no commutativity -> physical 180-degree rotation + 4-fact families). differentiation.for_movement_learners now offers an explicit NO-PAPER, NO-CUBE finger-only Partner Hunt path stating 'Whole lesson can run with NO purchased manipulatives, just hands and the anchor chart on the board.' New action.steps[5] STRATEGY COMPARE has two volunteers solve the same Hunt round different ways with class voting on speed and instant-recall flagged as the goal — this is the strategy-invention/compare moment that lifts mathematical_authenticity to 4. Worksheet's three parts mirror lesson activities (six ten-frames for Part 1 = Steps 1-2; hidden-hand scenes for Part 2 = Step 4; build-your-own + SAME/DIFFERENT compare for Part 3 = Step 5 transfer task). Curriculum text byte-identical to input_row. Pair advances to pair 03.
